newsitem.title: HUNGARY: STYL TO BUY 10,000 OWN SHARES.
newsitem.headline: STYL TO BUY 10,000 OWN SHARES.

text.p: Hungarian clothing manufacturer Styl Ruhagyar Rt said it gave a commission to a brokerage for the buyback of 10,000 of its own shares.
In a statement, published in the official bourse gazette this morning, Styl said the order, to be met at market price, was lodged on December 11.
The company did not give any reason for the purchase.
Styl has an issued share capital of 1.18 billion forints, made up of 1,000 forint face value shares.
On Wednesday Styl shares closed at 800 forints, unchanged from Tuesday. -- Budapest newsroom + 36 1 327-4040
